en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a cobblestoned intersection lined with multi‑story stone buildings. At the center stands a large rectangular school building with rows of windows and a main entrance framed by stonework. People are walking and standing along the sidewalks, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing. Printed caption at the bottom names Trento and the street (with one name crossed out and replaced). Text on the facade of the central building identifies it as an elementary school.
